skill.name: when-creating-presentations-use-pptx-generation
skill.description: Generate professional PowerPoint decks with structured content, pptxgenjs guidance, accessibility checks, and companion documentation.
skill.summary: Create accessible PowerPoint presentations from structured outlines with repeatable design and validation steps.
skill.author: DNYoussef

Review found these are expected documentation examples for generating PowerPoint files and accessibility reports; no prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or hidden command execution was found.

content.value_statement: Manual presentation production can be slow and inconsistent. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through structured PPTX generation and validation.
actual_capabilities: Structures presentation metadata, audience, purpose, outline, and slide sections before generation.
Defines reusable color, font, spacing, layout, and accessibility constraints for deck design.
Uses pptxgenjs patterns to create slides, text blocks, charts, notes, and final PPTX output.
Adds validation steps for contrast, alt text, reading order, data integrity, file size, and slide count.
Produces companion accessibility reports and presentation documentation alongside the deck.
limitations: It provides workflow and code patterns; it is not a complete packaged application.
Users must supply accurate content, data, brand rules, and review requirements.
pptxgenjs and optional generation tools must be available in the execution environment.
Accessibility checks are guidance-based and should be reviewed with real PowerPoint inspection tools.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Board Decks
use_cases.description: Turn business updates, metrics, decisions, and recommendations into a structured deck with notes and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Create Technical Report Slides
use_cases.description: Convert architecture summaries, implementation plans, or analysis findings into readable slides with charts and clear sections.

use_cases.title: Build Client Proposal Presentations
use_cases.description: Generate proposal decks with consistent layouts, data visuals, next steps, accessibility checks, and supporting documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10-slide PowerPoint deck from this outline. Include a title slide, agenda, main points, summary, and speaker notes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Data Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with charts and tables.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a business review deck from these metrics. Recommend chart types, add short insights, and include validation notes for each data slide.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand and Accessibility Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a branded PPTX using these colors, fonts, and layout rules. Check contrast, alt text, reading order, and slide consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Produce an Executive Board Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete deck package.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-slide board package with sections, charts, speaker notes, an accessibility report, and presentation documentation for review.

output_examples.input: Quarterly business review outline with revenue metrics, risks, and recommended actions.
output: A structured QBR deck with executive summary, metric slides, risk analysis, and next steps.
Speaker notes and an accessibility report prepared for final review.

output_examples.input: Technical architecture brief for a new internal platform.
output_examples.output: A technical presentation with overview, system sections, diagrams described in slide notes, implementation timeline, and validation checklist.

output_examples.input: Client proposal notes with goals, scope, timeline, and pricing themes.
output_examples.output: A proposal deck with clear sections, consistent layouts, decision-focused summaries, and companion documentation for handoff.

best_practices: Provide slide goals, audience, data sources, and required tone before generation begins.
Set brand colors, fonts, chart styles, and accessibility rules before creating slides.
Review the generated PPTX, report, and notes before sharing externally.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent missing business data or source claims.
Do not generate large decks without an approved outline and slide count.
Do not treat guidance-based accessibility checks as a replacement for human review.

faq.question: Does this skill create actual PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: It guides an agent to generate PPTX files using pptxgenjs patterns and a structured export workflow.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when file generation tools and dependencies are available.

faq.question: Does it enforce WCAG compliance?
faq.answer: It includes checks for contrast, alt text, reading order, and accessibility reports, but final compliance needs review.

faq.question: Can it handle charts and tables?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes data analysis, chart selection, chart generation, and data integrity checks.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide an outline, audience, purpose, source data, brand rules, and any required slide count.

faq.question: What outputs should I expect?
faq.answer: A PPTX file, accessibility report, slide notes, and presentation documentation when the workflow is completed.
